the self inflating bag-valve mask (BVM) was not an effective device for pre-oxygenation in healthy volunteers, and the non-rebreathing mask (NRM), although not as effective as the BVM, performed better.
the self-inflatable bag-valve-mask was less effective than the non-rebreather in achieving pre-oxygenation in healthy volunteers.
the NRM performed as well as the BVM in preoxygenation, was subjectively easier to breathe through, and was associated with a smaller increase in FECO 2.

the development of new and more efficient ways to deliver oxygen to patients in need of emergency resuscitation.

the NRM is the best device for pre-oxygenation in spontaneously breathing patients.
